title: NOMOS Chain Verification Request
description: Request body for POST /verify (NOMOS-SPEC-007 §6) — a presenter offering a sealed artifact and a certificate chain to a relying party it has no prior relationship with.

version.description: Wire envelope version. A verifier MUST reject any value it does not recognize with MALFORMED rather than guess at an unfamiliar shape.

key_certs.description: The chain (NOMOS-SPEC-007 §4) — an unordered set of key certificates. MAY be empty if the artifact's own signing key equals the pinned root. A verifier MUST reject more than 20 entries without attempting to walk them.

root_public_key_pem.description: The root the relying party's OWN configuration has decided to trust. MUST NOT be sourced from anything else in this request — see NOMOS-SPEC-007 §10.2.

facts.description: Optional. When present, and only once the chain resolves to a recognized, unrevoked issuer (NOMOS-SPEC-007 §7), the artifact's own rules are evaluated against these facts.

action.description: Optional human-readable label for what is being asked. Has no normative effect on the verdict.
